title: Task dossier entry
description: One entry of a board task's dossier (docs/design/task-dossier.md, ADR-0070): the one append-only record the Workers of a task's attempts coordinate through, carried across attempts. Each entry is its own content-hashed artifact (`plan`, `report`, `finding`, or `evidence` kind by its `kind`); it names the entry before it (`prev`), so the dossier at an entry is a hash chain no entry can be changed in or taken out of unseen. The engine numbers entries per task (`seq`, from 1, no gap) and never rewrites one.

seq.description: The entry's place in its task's dossier, from 1.

prev.description: The entry before this one (seq - 1); absent only on the first.

attempt.description: The attempt of the task the entry was written in.

kind.description: `plan`: the author at the start (approach, files, risks). `progress`: after a step (what was done, commits, what remains, small decisions and why). `review`: a reviewer's findings, bound to the subject reviewed, its result linked, not copied. `response`: the author per finding (fixed in which commit, or not and why). `evidence`: the engine's (checks, acceptance, report, landing); a Worker never writes one.

author.description: Who wrote it: a Worker through its step's gated tool or as its step's answer, or the engine (`system`, ref `workflow`).

execution.description: The Worker execution of the step that appended it.

refs.description: Artifacts the entry links, never copies: a step's result, a review's assessment, a decision, a check run.

subject.description: The exact subject the entry is about: what a review reviewed, the tree a step left.

commits.description: Commits the entry names (a progress's, a response's fix), as hex ids.

finding.description: On a response: the finding it answers, as the review named it.

inReplyTo.description: On a response: the review entry it answers.
